Preferred for single character splitters

```suggestion
	ED_SHORTCUT_AND_COMMAND("editor/reload_plugins", TTRC("Reload Selected Plugins"), KeyModifierMask::ALT | KeyModifierMask::SHIFT | Key::R);
```
More clear what it does.
The names should also have disabled auto-translation.
That's not a reliable way to find plugins, they can be nested. EditorPluginSettings has a method to get all plugins.
You could just check if the item is checked, no need to search the map.
Should also be disabled if none of the plugins is selected.
Please remove the icon. Reloading plugins isn't a hot path for regular users.
That's not accurate. The option reloads plugins selected in the menu (which is not the same as enabled plugins).

Ok, then.. this whole menu is inexcusably confusing from a usability perspective. I thought the checkboxes indicated whether the plugins were enabled or not, but you're telling me the checked state is only about whether they will be reloaded if you select them? Sorry, that is bad UX.
